title: A collection exports as clip files numbered in collection order
description:
As a crate digger, I want a collection's kept clips as clip files in the collection's order, so that the DAW's browser shows my digging session the way I arranged it.

```gherkin
Feature: A collection exported as a folder of clip files
  Background:
    Given a library with the analyzed sample "marine-band/Thunderer.mp3" in Bb, with the clips "loop-1" (bars 3-4) and "shot-2" (one beat, in section B)
    And the analyzed sample "loc/edison-rag.mp3" with my clip "riff" (1 bar, in F)
    And the collection "digs" holding, in order, "riff", "loop-1" and "shot-2"

  Scenario: One clip file per item, numbered in collection order
    When I export the collection "digs" to "out" from the library
    Then the export succeeds
    And the folder "out/digs" holds, in name order:
      | file                         |
      | 01 1bar-F riff.alc           |
      | 02 A-2bars-Bb loop-1.alc     |
      | 03 B-1beat-Bb shot-2.alc     |

  Scenario: Each clip file plays its clip from the library's audio
    When I export the collection "digs" to "out" from the library
    Then "out/digs/01 1bar-F riff.alc" plays the library's audio for "loc/edison-rag.mp3" over the clip "riff"

  Scenario: Moving an item re-numbers the files on the next export
    Given "shot-2" is moved to the top of "digs"
    When I export the collection "digs" to "out" from the library with "--force"
    Then the folder "out/digs" holds "01 B-1beat-Bb shot-2.alc" and no file starting "03 B-1beat"

  Scenario: A skipped item is no longer in the folder
    Given "loop-1" is removed from "digs"
    When I export the collection "digs" to "out" from the library with "--force"
    Then no file in "out/digs" is for "loop-1"
```

File names after the position follow the shared rule (apricitus-f5b805); the examples above assume it.
